question: Which users started the most topics in Dev?

question: Which 20 users wrote the most posts in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT u.username, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY post_count DESC, u.username LIMIT 20;

question: What is the number of topics are tagged solved?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count FROM topics t JOIN topic_tags tt ON tt.topic_id=t.id JOIN tags tg ON tg.id=tt.tag_id WHERE tg.name = 'solved' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL;

question: Which chat channels has user_0459 posted in?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel, COUNT(*) AS messages FROM chat_messages cm JOIN chat_channels cc ON cc.id=cm.chat_channel_id JOIN users u ON u.id=cm.user_id WHERE u.username = 'user_0459' GROUP BY cc.id, cc.name ORDER BY messages DESC, channel LIMIT 20;
